name: Meluri–Lay Shi National Highway
significance: NH 202K is a branch of NH 202. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Meluri to Lay Shi, and it meets NH 202 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 202 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Mokokchung to New Lambulane

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
